experiment: N3COND B1: development-only SPSA coordinate conditioning of original Nov3rd vs scalar SPSA, at B*, with QAOA p=L on the same conditioner
authorization: Zach direct 20:34 Shanghai t3334u. Development only. SYK withdrawn and not resumed. Nov9 displacements stopped. This stream does not touch GR PR77's 1000-seed benchmark, its frozen recipe, or its final panel. FT owns initialization and restart allocation. Local owns perturbation and schedules. No depth transfer.
written: before any N3COND energy query, including the dev scale block
model: H = sum_{i<j} J_ij Z_i Z_j - B* sum_i X_i. J_ij iid N(0, 1/N) on i<j, diagonal 0, row-major fill, numpy Generator(seed). Z|0>=+|0>, site i = bit i, LSB = site 0. No longitudinal field. This is not eq. (1) of arXiv:2204.02923, which uses a -1/2 double-counted sum, variance J/N, and an optional h_n.
Bstar: Per-instance refined argmax of S_A of the exact GS. A = sites 0..floor(N/2)-1. Grid [0.02, 3.0] x 75, bounded refinement xatol 1e-6. Accept only if interior grid argmax, interior refinement, unique Perron-positive GS, GS flip-even, residual < 1e-9, E1 in the odd sector, and gap_even > 0. A rejected instance is reported and not replaced. GS preparation is classical and is not charged to Q. No data oracle.
circuit_Nov3: |0> -> [U_c^X -> bare shell SNAP]^L -> W. U_c^X = W exp(-i gamma [J + theta_K Khat + theta_M Mhat]·ZZ) W. W = H^{tensor N}. One gamma and one (theta_K, theta_M) shared by every layer. SNAP per layer, shared across cavities: phase(p) = s1*p + s2*p*(p-1)/2 + s3*[p==3]. K = sym(offdiag(J@J)), M = inter-cavity block means of J with intra-cavity 0, both RMS-matched to J. No per-layer gamma, no dropped family, no displacement, no GCS ansatz.
circuit_QAOA: |+> -> [exp(-i gamma_l H_ZZ) exp(-i beta_l sum X)]^{p=L}, 2L independent angles. Same H, same SPSA rule, same Q.
identity: theta=0 and s2=s3=0 is QAOA with gamma_l=gamma and beta_l=-s1_l/2, up to the global phase exp(-i s1_l N/2) per layer from s1*popcount = s1*sum(1-Z)/2. The phase does not change energy or fidelity. The |+> rewrite |+>->[U_cZ -> WSW]^L matches the |0> circuit exactly.
paper: arXiv:2204.02923 (Schindler, Guaita, Shi, Demler, Cirac), PRL 129, 220401. Their M_nm is the GCS entangler, not the cavity-block feature M. Their optimizer is natural gradient, which is not used. Their weighted-graph-state picture is not adopted. No new ansatz is introduced.
not_this_stream: Nov9 real, imaginary, or complex displacement
charged L1 to L_target depth transfer (local R4 energy wins 1/16, 0/8 at 4096)

seeds.split_rule: Fixed before any energy query. Scale and gain are functions of dev_scale cold-start probes only. Holdout energies are never an input to lambda or a0. Dev paired deltas are descriptive and biased toward C1. The predictive check is the holdout.

batch_B2_precommitted.when: After B1 files exist and conformance still passes. New scale freeze at N=12 on dev_scale only, committed before N=12 fits. The 0.02 rule is not refit on B1.

batch_later_gate: N=15 or 18 only if both N=9 and N=12 holdout median Delta F (Nov3 C1-C0) at L=3, q=1024 are >= 0.02, and a single N=12 L=3 q=1024 Nov3 energy-call wall time, times the N=15 task count, is under 6 hours on 4 workers. Otherwise do not start them.

budget.Q: q*L, fully inclusive of calibration, perturbations, and candidates
budget.per_start: 8 calibration queries (4 two-sided) + 2K perturbations + 2 candidates (last, Polyak tail min(64,K))
budget.diag_recompute: One uncharged state rebuild after selection, labeled diag_recompute_not_charged, used only for F, parity, and norm. Selection uses counted candidate energies only.

init.Nov3_start0: gamma=0.375, theta=0, s1_l=-2*beta_TQA_l, s2=s3=0, with beta_TQA_l=-(1-t_l)*0.75 and t_l=(l+0.5)/L. This is the shared-gamma embedding of the protocol TQA ramp, not a searched init.
init.paired_starts: C0 and C1 use the same starts and the same SPSA Rademacher stream (circuit_id, stream 0). The conditioner is the only difference.

conditioners.C0: Existing scalar SPSA. sigma = sigma0. Each start sets its own gain a from the 8 calibration queries so the median initial step is 0.5 sigma. Those queries count inside Q.
conditioners.C1: Diagonal coordinate scale. sigma_j = sigma0_j * lambda_j, gain a = a0, both frozen. The 8 calibration queries still run and count inside Q, and the gain they would have set is recorded and discarded.

scale_block.where: dev_scale seeds only, at the 4 cold starts, before any fit
scale_block.probes: 4 two-sided probes per start at sigma0, c=1, stream 7. 4*4*8 = 128 energy queries per (N,L,circuit). Not taken out of Q. Reported as scale_block_queries.
scale_block.lambda: g_j = median |component| over probes. lambda_j = clip(median(g)/g_j, 0.25, 4). a0 = 0.5*(26)**0.602 / median(lambda*g).
scale_block.freeze: One lambda and a0 per (N, L, circuit), pooled over the 4 dev seeds. Holdout does not add probes. QAOA is scaled on its own coordinates the same way.

rng: SeedSequence([seed, N, 0, L, circuit_id, start, stream]). circuit_id QAOA=0, Nov3=40. method_id is circuit_id for C0 and circuit_id+1 for C1, recorded only. stream 0 SPSA Delta, 2 init, 7 scale probes. The b slot is 0 because the field is B*.
selection: Lowest counted candidate energy. Fidelity is computed after selection and is not a target, a stop, or a hyperparameter.

contrasts: Nov3 C1-C0 paired F and E
QAOA C1-C0 paired F and E
Nov3-QAOA paired F and E inside C0 and inside C1
primary_endpoint.reading: Conditioning helps Nov3 on this cell only if the holdout median Delta F (C1-C0) is >= 0.02 and the holdout median Delta E (C1-C0) is < 0. Otherwise do not adopt it. No second look, no seed swap, no threshold edit. With 4 holdout points the bootstrap CI of the mean is descriptive.
primary_endpoint.also_report: dev band separately, L=1, q=128 and q=512, min F, 25th percentile, fraction F>=0.5, win counts, query totals, wall time

failures: A non-finite energy or an exception is logged, status=failure, and scored at start-0 energy. The run file is kept.
threads: OMP, OPENBLAS, MKL, NUMEXPR threads = 1. Up to 4 worker processes.
outputs: results/N3COND/ only. Do not write results/IMAX, results/LE, or any final-seed archive.
